# Vendored browser inference assets

Qwen3.5 0.8B weights in both WebGPU quantizations, tokenizers, model configs and compiled WebLLM WASM. SHA-256 checksums and immutable source revisions are in manifest.json. Files are split into <=64 MiB parts for GitHub; the web build verifies and reassembles them. Model weights retain Qwen Apache-2.0 terms; compiled WebLLM libraries retain upstream terms in WEBLLM-LICENSE. No model code is executed by this download script.
